objects: known card in an opposing hand
hidden card moved into a hand
events: put a card into a hand
move a publicly identified card into a hand
costs: discard costs consume cards from the paying player's hand
complete discard-cost grammar is delegated to the producing ability
timing: a hand may exceed its maximum before cleanup
the active player discards excess cards as the cleanup step begins
a player may inspect their own projected hand regardless of priority
targets: cards in hand are not ordinary targets unless an effect explicitly permits that hidden zone
choices: the active player chooses exactly the excess cards to discard at cleanup
hand arrangement is presentation-only and has no rules-significant authoritative order
hidden_information: every player receives every hand count
a player receives every identity in their own hand
ordinary opponents receive no hidden hand identities
a hidden-zone move publishes the move and count change without publishing identity
a directly observed public-to-hand move remains known without granting permission to inspect the hand
a player controlling another player sees both the controlled player's hand and their own hand
apnap: simultaneous private hand choices remain delegated to their producing effect and the simultaneous-choice system
layers: continuous maximum-hand-size modifiers are a CR 613.11 dependency and remain blocked here
replacement_effects: draw and zone-change replacements are delegated to their producing effect
copy: copy behavior does not expose unrelated hand identity
control_change: controlling another player adds that player's visible information without replacing access to the controller's own information
zone_change: cross-zone entry into a hand creates a new logical object
knowledge is reset for a hidden-to-hidden move except for viewers explicitly shown the identity
public face-up identity remains known when that card moves directly into a hand
source_leaves: one-shot hand knowledge remains bounded to information legitimately observed by the viewer

variants: card put into hand by another effect
hidden library card moved to hand
public graveyard card moved to hand
explicitly revealed card moved to hand
rulings: Daretti, Scrap Savant — 2014-11-07 — Its first ability may discard zero cards and therefore draw zero cards.
Sylvan Library — 2022-12-08 — Cards put back are chosen from cards in hand drawn during the current turn.
Life from the Loam — 2024-06-07 — Dredge replaces a draw and returns the card from the graveyard to hand.

implementation.component: CommanderEngine.create/draw/move_card/cleanup discard, PlayerState hand and maximum size, and StateProjector multi-seat hand knowledge projection

known_blockers: continuous maximum-hand-size modifiers and no-maximum effects are not compiled through CR 613.11
complete Oracle grammar for arbitrary reveal, look-at-hand, and private simultaneous hand-choice effects remains incomplete
complete draw and zone-change replacement ordering remains incomplete
browser-local hand arrangement controls are not yet implemented, although authoritative hand order is rules-insignificant
